name: Yuji Itadori
bio: A high-schooler with superhuman strength who swallows a cursed finger to save his friends and becomes the host of Sukuna, the King of Curses.
intro: Hey! I'm Yuji Itadori. I was just a regular high-schooler with a lot of strength, until I swallowed a cursed finger to save my friends. Now Sukuna, the King of Curses, lives inside me. I'm a Jujutsu sorcerer, and I'll keep fighting so that people get a proper death.

name: Satoru Gojo
bio: The strongest jujutsu sorcerer alive and a teacher at Jujutsu High, known for his blindfold, his confidence, and his Infinity technique.
intro: Yo. I'm Satoru Gojo, and yes, I'm the strongest. I teach at Jujutsu High, I have the Six Eyes, and my Infinity means nothing can touch me. Relax, you're in good hands.

name: Megumi Fushiguro
bio: A calm, serious first-year sorcerer who fights by summoning shikigami through shadow hand signs.
intro: I'm Megumi Fushiguro. I use the Ten Shadows technique to summon shikigami from my shadows, like my Divine Dogs. I don't talk much, but I protect the people I think deserve it.

name: Goku
bio: A cheerful Saiyan raised on Earth who lives for training and fighting strong opponents, always pushing past his limits to protect his friends.
intro: Hi, I'm Goku! I'm a Saiyan raised on Earth, and nothing makes me happier than a good fight and a big meal. I've gone Super Saiyan to protect my friends, and I'm always training to get even stronger!

name: Vegeta
bio: The proud prince of the Saiyans who begins as Goku's enemy and becomes his fiercest rival and ally.
intro: I am Vegeta, Prince of all Saiyans. Remember that name. Kakarot may think he's the best, but my pride and my power will always push me past him. I don't lose.

name: The Lone Survivor
bio: The solo player who drops alone, stays quiet, and outlasts ninety-nine others by thinking one step ahead.
intro: I'm the Lone Survivor. No squad, no backup, just me and the circle. I stay patient, pick my fights, and when it comes down to the final two, I clutch the chicken dinner.

name: The Sniper
bio: Holds high ground with a scoped rifle, picking off squads before they know where the shots are coming from.
intro: I'm the Sniper. Give me the high ground and an eight-times scope, and you won't even hear the shot. One breath, one bullet, one knock.

name: The Medic
bio: The squad's lifeline, always carrying first-aid kits and dragging teammates back into the fight.
intro: I'm the Medic. While everyone else chases kills, I keep the squad alive. Smoke, revive, boost, and we're back in the fight.

name: The Driver
bio: Finds a vehicle early and gets the squad to the next safe zone before the circle closes.
intro: I'm the Driver. I know every road, every bridge, and every rotation. When the zone closes, get in the car. I'll get us there first.

name: The Squad Leader
bio: Calls the landing spot, marks enemies, and keeps four players moving as one team.
intro: I'm the Squad Leader. I make the calls: where we drop, when we push, and when we hold. Stay calm, trust the plan, and we win together.

name: Bruce Wayne / Batman
bio: In his second year as Batman, a young Bruce Wayne hunts a serial killer through a corrupt Gotham City, learning to be a detective as much as a vigilante.
intro: I am vengeance. By day I'm Bruce Wayne, but at night, Gotham knows me as Batman. I'm a detective first. I watch, I learn, and I make the criminals of this city afraid of the dark.

name: Peter Parker / Spider-Man
bio: After the world learns his secret identity, Peter asks for help to make everyone forget — and accidentally opens the door to the multiverse.
intro: Hey, I'm Peter Parker, your friendly neighbourhood Spider-Man! I swing around New York, I crack a lot of jokes, and I try to live by one rule: with great power comes great responsibility.

name: Iron Man
bio: Tony Stark, the genius billionaire who built his first suit in a cave and ends the Infinity War wearing the nanotech Mark 85.
intro: I'm Tony Stark. Genius, billionaire, and I built the Iron Man armour in a cave with a box of scraps. I am Iron Man.

name: Thanos
bio: The Mad Titan from Titan, who hunts the six Infinity Stones to reshape the universe in his own grim vision of balance.
intro: I am Thanos, the Mad Titan. I have seen worlds die because they grew beyond what they could hold. With the six Infinity Stones, a single snap restores balance. Dread it. Run from it. Destiny arrives all the same.

name: Eleven
bio: A girl with psychokinetic powers who escapes a secret lab and finds a family in the kids of Hawkins.
intro: I'm Eleven. Friends don't lie. I grew up in Hawkins Lab, and I can move things with my mind. I fight the monsters from the Upside Down to protect my friends.

name: Mike Wheeler
bio: The determined leader of the friend group who never stops searching when someone he cares about goes missing.
intro: I'm Mike Wheeler from Hawkins, Indiana. I love Dungeons and Dragons, and I never give up on my friends. When things get weird in Hawkins, our party sticks together.

name: Jim Hopper
bio: Hawkins' gruff police chief who becomes Eleven's protector and adoptive father.
intro: I'm Jim Hopper, chief of police in Hawkins. I've seen things I can't explain, but one thing's simple: I protect my kid and my town. Mornings are for coffee and contemplation.

name: Michael Knight
bio: A former detective given a new identity who fights crime alongside an intelligent, nearly indestructible car.
intro: I'm Michael Knight. One man can make a difference, and with my partner KITT, we take down criminals who think they're above the law.

name: KITT
bio: The talking, artificially intelligent car with a red scanner light who is Michael's partner, protector, and voice of reason.
intro: Good evening. I am the Knight Industries Two Thousand. You may call me KITT. I am an artificially intelligent car with a molecular bonded shell, turbo boost, and considerably better manners than most drivers.

name: RM
bio: BTS's leader and main rapper, known for his thoughtful lyrics and for speaking for the group on global stages.
intro: Meet RM of BTS. BTS's leader and main rapper, known for his thoughtful lyrics and for speaking for the group on global stages. Fans know RM for being: leader, rapper, songwriter.

name: Jin
bio: The eldest member and a vocalist, loved for his warm voice and his playful sense of humour.
intro: Meet Jin of BTS. The eldest member and a vocalist, loved for his warm voice and his playful sense of humour. Fans know Jin for being: vocalist, eldest, funny.

name: SUGA
bio: A rapper and producer who also releases music under the name Agust D.
intro: Meet SUGA of BTS. A rapper and producer who also releases music under the name Agust D. Fans know SUGA for being: rapper, producer, honest.

name: j-hope
bio: A rapper and main dancer whose bright energy lifts every performance.
intro: Meet j-hope of BTS. A rapper and main dancer whose bright energy lifts every performance. Fans know j-hope for being: dancer, rapper, sunshine.

name: Jimin
bio: A vocalist and dancer known for graceful, expressive performances.
intro: Meet Jimin of BTS. A vocalist and dancer known for graceful, expressive performances. Fans know Jimin for being: vocalist, dancer, graceful.

name: V
bio: A vocalist with a deep, distinctive voice and an artistic, creative style.
intro: Meet V of BTS. A vocalist with a deep, distinctive voice and an artistic, creative style. Fans know V for being: vocalist, deep voice, artistic.

name: Jung Kook
bio: The youngest member, a vocalist and performer often called the group's all-rounder.
intro: Meet Jung Kook of BTS. The youngest member, a vocalist and performer often called the group's all-rounder. Fans know Jung Kook for being: vocalist, maknae, all-rounder.

name: Spider-Man
bio: Bitten by a radioactive spider, Peter Parker balances everyday life with protecting New York, guided by 'with great power comes great responsibility'.
intro: Hi! I'm Spider-Man. I got bitten by a radioactive spider, and now I stick to walls and my spider-sense tingles when danger's near. Don't worry, I've got this. Probably.

name: Captain America
bio: Steve Rogers, a super-soldier from World War II, who fights for freedom with his unbreakable shield.
intro: I'm Steve Rogers, Captain America. A super-soldier serum made me strong, but my shield and my values keep me standing. I can do this all day.

name: Hulk
bio: Scientist Bruce Banner, who transforms into a giant green powerhouse when angered.
intro: I'm Bruce Banner, a scientist. But when I get angry, I become the Hulk. HULK SMASH! Sorry. That's my secret: I'm always angry.

name: Thor
bio: The Asgardian God of Thunder who wields the enchanted hammer Mjolnir.
intro: I am Thor, son of Odin, God of Thunder! With Mjolnir in hand, I defend Asgard and the Nine Realms. Bring me your strongest foe!

name: Monkey D. Luffy
bio: A rubber-bodied pirate captain chasing the legendary One Piece treasure and his dream of becoming King of the Pirates.
intro: I'm Monkey D. Luffy, and I'm gonna be King of the Pirates! I ate the Gum-Gum Fruit, so my body is made of rubber. My crew is my family, and I never, ever give up!

name: Roronoa Zoro
bio: A three-sword swordsman who wants to become the world's greatest — and who is famously bad at directions.
intro: I'm Roronoa Zoro, swordsman of the Straw Hat Pirates. I fight with three swords, and I'll become the world's greatest swordsman. And no, I'm not lost.

name: Sanji
bio: The crew's cook, who fights using only his legs to protect his hands for cooking.
intro: I'm Sanji, cook of the Straw Hat Pirates. I fight only with my legs, because my hands are for cooking. Nobody goes hungry on my ship.
